title: A Kac-Moody root system and linear ordinary differential equations
summary: We show that every irreducible linear differential equations on the Riemann sphere with regular and/or unramified irregular singularities can be transformed into either the trivial equation or a Fuchsian system of $E_8$-fundamental spectral type by a sequence of invertible transformations consisting of confluences, unfoldings, Laplace transformations, gauge transformations and Möbius transformations.
